name: Luanti
description: Open source voxel game engine, formerly Minetest.
summary: AI may help with simple tasks such as completion, boilerplate and small fixes; generating substantial code is strongly discouraged, and vibe-coding and autonomous use are banned. Communication must be your own text, with grammar and translation help allowed. Significant AI use must be disclosed.

evidence.quote: Generating substantial amounts of code with AI is strongly discouraged and may result in immediate closure of the PR.
On the other hand, "vibe-coding" or autonomous AI usage is completely unacceptable.
In any case, any significant AI usage used in a contribution must be disclosed in the PR description.
Using an LLM to debug an issue or search for security vulnerabilities, but make sure to verify the analysis completely and communicate it yourself.
Do not use AI-generated text when communicating with other humans, including when writing documentation.
That said, using AI tools to assist with grammar or translations on human-written text is fine.
